checks.name: causal exposure endpoints, represented width and zero shutter are explicit
constant unitY gold matches independent analytic exponential means in all24channels
birth clipping and extinction use the ORIGINAL whole-bin width, with no pre-birth emission
zero-width windows use the exact instantaneous limit at birth end and outside support
piecewise linear colour times exponential agrees with independent Simpson across knots
128-segment cooling LUT integrates actual RGB ageing rather than current colour times scalar I
provided root colour bound avoids full LUT evaluation and remains checked at visited nodes
narrow late windows retain finite energy even when absolute bin timestamps would collapse
zero source intensity, supplied output and linear optical scaling are independent of release time
all-phase colour bound covers every bin and final average without a second intensity multiplier
actual midpoint anchor samples only a past state and does not retain callback vectors
birth after midpoint uses an explicit virtual raster anchor, never a pre-birth or future sample
virtual anchor plus centre velocity places constant-velocity late-born bin locations correctly
invalid callbacks units bounds outputs and unsupported domains reject atomically
pure module introduces no runtime renderer timer imports or production source edits

limits: Pure fixed-release discrete-ember exposure, not complete continuous release-grid history or whole-scene exposure.
Linear colour-segment model is exact for the declared LUT interpolant; callback physics is authored.
Source motion, camera motion, depth, PSF and changing smoke transmission are outside this helper.
CPU correctness and bounded callback counts do not establish native frame cost or GPU visual acceptance.
